name: Tata Elxsi Ltd.
about: Tata Elxsi Limited provides product design and engineering, systems integration, and support services in India, the United States, Europe, and Internationally. The company operates through two segments, Systems Integration and Support, and Software Development and Services. It offers iCX, a SaaS-based solution for automating, monitoring, and managing CPEs; and AIVA, an AI-based video analytics platform that automates video tagging, object detection, content indexing, and metadata generation. It also provides QoEtient, a platform for video streaming services; TEPlay, an OTT/IPTV platform; Neuron, an autonomous network platform for telco operators; and uLike, a platform for AI-powered content recommendation engine. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~20% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~6% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 36 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 50), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 36 vs sector median 25; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 24, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
